title: Internal: Checking Debit Card Dispute Status
summary: This document explains how to check a customer’s checking debit card dispute history and the status of open disputes using the get_debit_dispute_status_7483(user_id) tool. It lists returned fields (dispute_id, transaction_id, disputed_amount, filing_date, status, provisional credit details, expected_resolution_date, resolution/outcome) and the full set of dispute statuses plus regulatory timeline checks: provisional credit within 10 days (20 for new accounts) and investigation within 45 days (90 for international/POS), with escalation guidance.
faqs: How do I retrieve a customer’s debit card dispute history and see the status of open disputes?
What fields does get_debit_dispute_status_7483(user_id) return for each dispute (IDs, amounts, dates, provisional credit, and resolution)?
What do the dispute statuses mean (OPEN, PENDING_DOCUMENTATION, UNDER_REVIEW, PROVISIONAL_CREDIT_ISSUED, and all resolved/closed outcomes)?
Within what regulatory timelines should provisional credit be issued, and what are the exceptions (new accounts)?
Within what regulatory timelines should the investigation complete, including international/POS cases?
If a dispute exceeds the expected timeline, what escalation step does the document recommend?
keywords: provisional credit within 10 days (20 new accounts)
